title: Auto Quest All World Origin - Shinrin
features:
🐲 RUAJAD HUB — World AutoQuest
Auto Quest script for Dragon Adventures. Supports all worlds from Origin → Shinrin.
Quest Tab
Toggle Auto Quest per world
Supports all 11 worlds:
Origins
Grassland
Jungle
Volcano
Tundra
Ocean
Desert
Fantasy
Wasteland
Prehistoric
Shinrin
Smart Loop reads the HUD and auto-pins quests
Quest priority order:
Kill Boss
Egg Quest
Treasure Chest
Kill Mobs
Harvest
Riding Ring
Spend Time (last)
If chests have not spawned yet, it skips to other quests first, then comes back later
Includes Map Patrol to fly around chest spawn points
Advanced Tab
One toggle farms continuously from Origin → Shinrin
Scans unlocked worlds
Skips already completed worlds and resumes from the furthest unlocked one
Auto-warps between worlds
Continues farming automatically after teleport
After auto-warp, hides the main GUI and leaves only the floating button
Saves progress across worlds / servers
Boss System
Flies to the boss queue point automatically
Creates the room / presses Start automatically
Auto-fights the boss
Auto-clears adds / minions
Auto-claims rewards after winning
After leaving the boss room, restarts the farm system automatically
Ghost Mode & Utility
Ghost Mode for damage bypass / entity bypass
Auto-Loot picks up drops instantly
Smooth Tween flight (rise → fly across → drop to attack)
Console logs are hidden while running
Teleport Tab
Instant teleport to any supported world
Covers all worlds used by Auto Quest
